diagnostics.balance_method: Actual routing intervals; trapezoidal external/spill flows; exact positive/negative split of linearly interpolated signed outfall endpoint flow. Sampling and solver approximations remain.
diagnostics.initial_state_note: Nominally dry input; actual engine-initialized node/link water is retained at t=0 and included in the balance, including SWMM's small dry-link depth floor.
diagnostics.raw_storage_units: Raw routing initStorage/finalStorage are internal ft3 in the pinned toolkit; never used as m3. All reported storage comes from converted live node/link VOLUME getters.
